name: One Last Goodbye
source:
One Last Goodbye is a queer visual novel with psychological horror elements about grief, love, and the silent violence of learning to live again.

Lake is twenty-five years old, works a minimum wage job, and shares an apartment with the ghost of his boyfriend.

Syun has been dead for almost two years. He's also been there every morning when Lake wakes up. There is no explanation for why he stayed. 

There is only the fact that he did, and the fact that Lake has built an entire life around making sure he doesn't leave again. 

[From [url=https://meiri.itch.io/one-last-goodbye]itch.io[/url]]
